attribution.method: live descendant GPU-role PID and birth identity matched to native observer; exact process PID in trace records

gpuIntervalDefinition: Metal System Trace metal-gpu-intervals: attributed start/duration/channel/state events, in nanoseconds relative to trace start.
allocationDefinition: Metal System Trace metal-current-allocated-size: MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize, total allocated Metal device memory reported for the app; not resident GPU memory or total process/device footprint.
limitations: One instrumented attempt, outside the four ordinary cohort attempts; discovery and tracing overhead is unquantified.
Only records for the live native GPU process are retained; other processes and raw trace environment/device metadata remain private.
Nested intervals and concurrent GPU channels overlap. Per-channel unions are observed coverage, not summed device utilization or total renderer work.
Capture is partial and does not establish final GPU-memory release, complete display-pipeline cost, or frame/presentation latency.
No hardware counter set or shader timeline was enabled.
Virtual-display session; no physical display, input, IME, screen reader, OSR comparison, quiet-machine or thermal qualification.
